nodes.name: Proposition 4.1.5
nodes.statement: For all dividing cover $p$ in $\mathbf{lSm}/\mathbb{A}_{\mathbb{N},B}$ and integer $d$, $\Theta_d(p)$ is an isomorphism.

nodes.name: Lemma 4.1.6, Lemma 4.1.14
nodes.statement:
Let $\theta\colon \mathbb{N}\to P$ be a vertical homomorphism of fs monoids.
Assume that $\overline{P}\simeq \mathbb{N}^n$ for some  integer $n\geq 1$.
If $F$ is a face of $P$ with $F\neq P$, then we have an isomorphism
\[
\Phi(\mathbb{A}_{P_F,B})
\simeq
\Phi(\mathbb{A}_{P,B}).
\]

Let $\mathbb{N}\to Q$ be a homomorphism of fs monoids, let $X\to \mathbb{A}_{Q,B}$ be a strict \'etale morphism in $\mathbf{lSch}$, let $X'\to X$ be a log \'etale monomorphism, and let $\Sigma$ be a subdivision of $\mathrm{Spec}(P)$ with $P:=Q^{\mathrm{tf}}$.
Then $\Theta(p)$ is an isomorphism, where $p\colon X'\times_{\mathbb{A}_{P}}\mathbb{T}_{\Sigma}\to X'$ is the projection.

nodes.name: Lemma 4.3.1
nodes.statement:
Suppose $Y\in \mathbf{lSch}$.
For all $V\in \mathbf{lSm}/Y$, $W\in \mathbf{Sm}/(Y-\partial Y)$, and integer $d$, there is a canonical equivalence
\[
\mathrm{map}_{\mathscr{C}(Y)}
(M(V)(d),M(W))
\simeq
\mathrm{map}_{\mathcal{SH}(\underline{V},\mathcal{V})}
(M(\underline{V})(d),M(\underline{V\times_{Y}W})).
\]

nodes.name: Lemma 4.3.3
nodes.statement:
Suppose $X\in \mathbf{lSm}/{\mathbb{A}_{\mathbb{N},B}}$.
For every integer $d$, there is a canonical equivalence
\[
\Theta_d(X)
\simeq 
\mathrm{map}_{dver^{-1}\mathscr{C}_{dNis}(\mathbb{A}_{\mathbb{N},B})}
(M(X)(d),M(C)).
\]

nodes.name: Lemma 4.3.2
nodes.statement:
Suppose $X\in \mathbf{lSm}/{\mathbb{A}_{\mathbb{N},B}}$.
If $X$ is vertical over $\mathbb{A}_{\mathbb{N},B}$, then for every integer $d$, there is a canonical equivalence
\[
\mathrm{map}_{\mathscr{C}(\mathbb{A}_{\mathbb{N},B})}
(M(X)(d),M(C))
\simeq
\mathrm{map}_{\mathscr{C}_{dNis}(\mathbb{A}_{\mathbb{N},B})}
(M(X)(d),M(C)).
\]

nodes.name: Theorem 4.3.4
nodes.statement:
Suppose $X\in \mathbf{lSm}/{\mathbb{A}_{\mathbb{N},B}}$.
For every integer $d$, there is a canonical equivalence
\[
\Theta_d(X)
\simeq
\mathrm{map}_{\mathcal{SH}(X,\mathcal{V})}
(M(X)(d),M(X\times_{\mathbb{A}_{\mathbb{N},B}}C)).
\]
